whoItsFor: Developers and marketers using Claude who want SEO and GEO data (Search Console, GA4, keyword and backlink data) through an MCP server and ready-made skills. It is aimed at people who want to run audits and keyword research from Claude without a paid SEO tool subscription.
useCases: Run a full SEO site audit covering indexation, CTR anomalies, and decaying pages
Track rank movers between two periods using Search Console data
Find competitor keywords and backlinks that the user is missing
installCommand: claude mcp add ryze --transport http https://connector.get-ryze.ai/mcp
